owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params.expiresAt: Screening expiry (unix seconds). Max 2 years out.
params.pronouncementHash: keccak256 of the board resolution document.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

MAX_EXPIRY_PERIOD().notice: Maximum screening validity period (prevents stale entries).

TIMELOCK_PERIOD().notice: Minimum time between a proposal and its execution.

boardRole(address).notice: Board members who can propose + execute screening changes.

cancelProposal(address).notice: Cancel a pending proposal before it is executed.

executeRemoval(address).notice: Execute a pending removal after the timelock has elapsed.

executeScreening(address).notice: Execute a previously proposed screening after the timelock has elapsed.

getScreening(address).notice: Returns the full Screening struct for an adapter.

isScreened(address).notice: Returns true only when the adapter is screened AND the screening         has not expired.  ShariahVaultV2 calls this before deployCapital.

proposeRemoval(address).notice: Propose removal of a screened adapter.

proposeScreening(address,bytes32,uint256.notice: Propose a new or updated screening for an adapter.
